name: AI Trend Studio
tagline: AI video generator with trending effects like AI Kiss and AI Hug.
description: AI Trend Studio is a chat-directed AI studio for making trending short videos and images. Upload a photo or type a prompt and turn it into image-to-video or text-to-video clips with popular effects such as AI Kiss, AI Hug, AI Muscle, AI Dance, Flash Fashion, AI Baby, Action Figure and Ghibli Style. Video runs on MiniMax H3, Seedance 2.0 Mini and Muse; stills use GPT Image and Nano Banana. Pricing is credit-based: plans start at $9.90/month (80 credits), one-time packs from $9.90 for 50 credits, a free daily check-in gives up to 10 credits a week, and failed renders are refunded.
